def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # The function sigmoid(2t) is not symmetric about t=0 under reflection x -> 1-x,
    # since t = 6x - 3 becomes -t under this map, and sigmoid(2*(-t)) = 1 - sigmoid(2t)
    # However, the trained MLP may not perfectly capture anti-symmetry,
    # but a defect breaking the trajectory similarity (e.g., wrong sign, shift) would break this.
    # We expect y_new ≈ 1 - y_orig due to the functional symmetry
    expected_y_new = 1.0 - y_orig
    return abs(y_new - expected_y_new) <= 1e-6
